facts.plausibility: Nummular dermatitis can produce intensely pruritic, well-demarcated coin-shaped eczematous plaques.
facts.discriminator: Coin-shaped bilateral plaques without burrows or a person-to-person exposure pattern are less consistent with scabies.
facts.correct_context: Well-demarcated circular or oval plaques on the limbs or trunk, especially with xerosis, favour nummular dermatitis.

next_actions.trigger: typical coin-shaped eczematous plaques without infestation features
next_actions.action: Treat the eczematous process with skin-barrier care and topical anti-inflammatory therapy; investigate contact allergy or infection when indicated.

rows.single_source_exception: One current specialty reference directly covers the candidate; independent semantic review required.

facts.plausibility: Bedbug bites can cause pruritic papules after household exposure.
facts.discriminator: Exposed-site grouped bites without scabetic burrows or the characteristic scabies distribution favour bedbugs over scabies.
facts.correct_context: New crops of pruritic papules after sleeping in an infested environment favour bedbug bites.

next_actions.trigger: compatible bites with environmental evidence of infestation
next_actions.action: Arrange environmental eradication and symptomatic skin care.

rows.single_source_exception: One current specialty reference directly covers presentation, differential diagnosis, confirmation, and coeliac evaluation; independent semantic review required.

facts.plausibility: Dermatitis herpetiformis is an intensely pruritic papulovesicular eruption.
facts.discriminator: A symmetric extensor eruption with enteropathy differs from a painful unilateral dermatomal zoster eruption.
facts.correct_context: Grouped excoriated vesicles on extensor surfaces with coeliac disease favour dermatitis herpetiformis.

next_actions.trigger: suspected dermatitis herpetiformis
next_actions.action: Confirm with appropriate skin testing and evaluate for associated coeliac disease.

rows.single_source_exception: One current specialty reference directly covers the phototoxic eruption; independent semantic review required.

facts.plausibility: Phytophotodermatitis can produce painful erythema and blisters.
facts.discriminator: Linear lesions confined to sun-exposed plant-contact sites and later hyperpigmentation differ from dermatomal zoster.
facts.correct_context: A painful non-itchy linear blistering eruption after plant sap and ultraviolet exposure favours phytophotodermatitis.

next_actions.trigger: recognized phototoxic plant exposure
next_actions.action: Stop the exposure, protect from ultraviolet light, and provide symptomatic skin care.

facts.plausibility: A blue nevus is a pigmented melanocytic lesion that can enter the differential for melanoma.
facts.discriminator: A small symmetric blue-grey lesion that remains unchanged is less suspicious than an evolving asymmetric melanoma.
facts.correct_context: A longstanding solitary smooth blue-grey papule with stable size and shape favours a common blue nevus.

next_actions.trigger: new or changing blue lesion or diagnostic uncertainty
next_actions.action: Perform dermoscopic assessment and biopsy or specialist referral when melanoma cannot be excluded.

facts.plausibility: Solar lentigo is a common benign pigmented macule on chronically sun-exposed skin.
facts.discriminator: Uniform colour and long-term stability reduce concern relative to an evolving variegated melanoma.
facts.correct_context: A sharply demarcated, uniformly pigmented, stable macule on sun-damaged skin favours solar lentigo.

next_actions.trigger: atypical or changing lentigo-like lesion
next_actions.action: Use dermoscopy and biopsy when melanoma in situ cannot be confidently excluded.

facts.plausibility: Cow's milk protein allergy can produce gastrointestinal manifestations and can affect infant growth, so it may enter a broader gastrointestinal differential when allergic features coexist.
facts.discriminator: A classic withholding-retention pattern with fecal loading directly supports retentive fecal incontinence rather than allergy.
facts.correct_context: A reproducible cow's-milk relationship plus other allergic or inflammatory gastrointestinal manifestations would increase suspicion for cow's milk protein allergy.

next_actions.trigger: credible allergy features accompanying gastrointestinal symptoms
next_actions.action: Undertake a clinician-supervised allergy-focused assessment rather than attributing retentive incontinence to allergy alone.

facts.plausibility: Appendicitis is an important gastrointestinal alternative cause of vomiting and abdominal symptoms during pregnancy.
facts.discriminator: Persistent vomiting with starvation, dehydration, and no focal peritoneal findings favours hyperemesis over appendicitis.
facts.correct_context: Progressive focal abdominal pain with localized tenderness or peritoneal findings favours acute appendicitis.

next_actions.trigger: pregnancy with focal abdominal pain or peritoneal findings
next_actions.action: Obtain urgent surgical and obstetric assessment with pregnancy-appropriate imaging.

facts.plausibility: Diabetic ketoacidosis is a metabolic alternative cause of vomiting and physiologic compromise in pregnancy.
facts.discriminator: Hyperglycemia, acidosis, and ketonemia beyond starvation ketosis favour diabetic ketoacidosis rather than hyperemesis.
facts.correct_context: Vomiting with diabetes, metabolic acidosis, and significant ketonemia favours diabetic ketoacidosis.

next_actions.trigger: suspected diabetic ketoacidosis in pregnancy
next_actions.action: Begin urgent metabolic stabilization while confirming glucose, ketones, electrolytes, and acid-base status.

facts.plausibility: Nuchal translucency ultrasound is a first-trimester screening component relevant to aneuploidy risk assessment.
facts.discriminator: Nuchal translucency and cell-free DNA differ in method, timing, and screening information and neither is a diagnostic karyotype.
facts.correct_context: A patient choosing first-trimester ultrasound-based risk assessment or needing structural information may appropriately receive nuchal translucency assessment.

next_actions.trigger: abnormal screening result or ultrasound marker
next_actions.action: Provide counselling and offer appropriate diagnostic testing rather than treating the screen as diagnostic.

facts.plausibility: A cervical lesion can cause antepartum vaginal bleeding.
facts.discriminator: Cervical-source bleeding without uterine tenderness or fetal compromise is less consistent with placental abruption.
facts.correct_context: Bleeding visualized from a cervical lesion on speculum examination with a non-tender uterus favours a cervical source.

next_actions.trigger: suspected non-placental cervical bleeding after placental location is assessed
next_actions.action: Perform appropriate speculum evaluation and arrange investigation of the cervical lesion.

facts.plausibility: Preterm labour can present with bleeding and painful regular contractions before 37 weeks.
facts.discriminator: Cervical change with regular contractions favours preterm labour; a tense tender uterus and fetal compromise favour abruption.
facts.correct_context: Regular contractions with progressive cervical dilation or effacement favour preterm labour.

next_actions.trigger: suspected preterm labour
next_actions.action: Assess maternal-fetal status and cervical change promptly and initiate gestation-appropriate obstetric management.

rows.single_source_exception: One comprehensive current specialty guideline directly compares aspiration with catheter drainage; independent semantic review required.

facts.plausibility: Therapeutic thoracentesis removes pleural fluid and can transiently relieve symptoms.
facts.discriminator: Established complicated parapneumonic effusion or empyema requires ongoing infected-collection drainage; one-time aspiration alone is inadequate source control.
facts.correct_context: A free-flowing non-infected symptomatic effusion may be managed with therapeutic aspiration when continuous drainage is not indicated.

next_actions.trigger: confirmed pleural infection or low-pH complicated parapneumonic effusion
next_actions.action: Insert an image-guided small-bore chest tube and give appropriate antibiotics.

rows.single_source_exception: One current international emergency-surgery guideline gives a strong high-quality recommendation; independent semantic review required.

facts.plausibility: Serial abdominal examinations are relevant to many evolving abdominal presentations.
facts.discriminator: When acute mesenteric ischemia is suspected, serial observation delays the recommended immediate CT angiography.
facts.correct_context: Serial examinations are appropriate only after a time-critical vascular catastrophe has been sufficiently excluded or while definitive care is already underway.

next_actions.trigger: clinical suspicion of acute mesenteric ischemia
next_actions.action: Perform computed tomography angiography without delay.

rows.single_source_exception: One current international emergency-surgery guideline directly establishes CT angiography as the diagnostic study of choice; independent semantic review required.

facts.plausibility: Plain abdominal radiography is a familiar initial investigation for some acute abdominal syndromes.
facts.discriminator: Plain radiography cannot evaluate mesenteric arterial or venous occlusion and must not delay CT angiography for suspected acute mesenteric ischemia.
facts.correct_context: Plain radiography may address another suspected abdominal process but is not the definitive urgent vascular test for mesenteric ischemia.

next_actions.trigger: clinical suspicion of acute mesenteric ischemia
next_actions.action: Proceed directly to computed tomography angiography rather than relying on plain radiography.

facts.plausibility: Rumination disorder can present with recurrent regurgitation and can be confused with self-induced vomiting.
facts.discriminator: Regurgitation not driven by weight or shape overvaluation differs from binge eating followed by compensatory behaviour in bulimia nervosa.
facts.correct_context: Effortless recurrent regurgitation without binge episodes or weight-shape motivation favours rumination disorder.

next_actions.trigger: suspected rumination disorder
next_actions.action: Complete feeding/eating and gastrointestinal assessment and arrange behavioural treatment appropriate to rumination.

facts.plausibility: Anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa both involve weight and shape overvaluation and disordered eating.
facts.discriminator: Persistently low weight with restriction and no recurrent binge-purge pattern favours anorexia nervosa, restricting type.
facts.correct_context: Significantly low body weight maintained by restriction without recurrent binge eating or purging favours anorexia nervosa, restricting type.

next_actions.trigger: suspected anorexia nervosa
next_actions.action: Assess medical instability and nutritional risk promptly and refer for coordinated eating-disorder treatment.

facts.plausibility: Dependent and borderline personality disorders can both involve intense interpersonal dependence and fear of separation.
facts.discriminator: Submissive clinging and difficulty making decisions without reassurance differ from borderline instability, impulsivity, anger, and self-harm.
facts.correct_context: A pervasive pattern of submissive care-seeking, difficulty making everyday decisions, and fear of being unable to care for oneself favours dependent personality disorder.

next_actions.trigger: suspected dependent personality disorder
next_actions.action: Confirm the longitudinal pervasive pattern and arrange appropriate psychotherapy-focused care.

facts.plausibility: Complex post-traumatic stress disorder can include affect dysregulation, negative self-concept, and relational disturbance that overlap with borderline presentations.
facts.discriminator: A trauma-linked syndrome with PTSD features and disturbances in self-organization differs from a pervasive borderline pattern not contingent on trauma reminders.
facts.correct_context: Core PTSD symptoms plus persistent affect, self-concept, and relational disturbance after prolonged trauma favour complex post-traumatic stress disorder.

next_actions.trigger: suspected complex post-traumatic stress disorder
next_actions.action: Perform trauma-informed assessment, evaluate safety and comorbidity, and arrange evidence-based trauma-focused care.

facts.plausibility: Vortioxetine is an evidence-based antidepressant option for major depressive disorder.
facts.discriminator: Vortioxetine cannot be assumed inferior to an SSRI without patient-specific treatment history, tolerability, and preference information.
facts.correct_context: Prior inadequate response or a patient-specific reason to select vortioxetine can make it a reasonable antidepressant choice.

facts.plausibility: A monoamine oxidase inhibitor is an antidepressant strategy that can be effective in selected depressive illness.
facts.discriminator: Interaction burden, dietary restrictions, and specialist-monitoring requirements make an MAOI inferior to a standard first-line SSRI in an uncomplicated initial presentation.
facts.correct_context: Treatment-resistant or selected atypical depression under specialist management may justify an MAOI after safer first-line options are inadequate.

next_actions.trigger: considering an MAOI after inadequate standard treatment
next_actions.action: Use specialist-guided prescribing with medication-interaction review, washout planning, and dietary counselling.
